note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #7, Q2 2025 Government Performance; exports mexico_2025_q2safety_govperformance.csv) keeps INEGI columns bp3_1_01..bp3_1_16, bp3_1_99, bp3_2, bp3_2a, bp3_3, bp3_4, bp3_5, bp3_6 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0625.csv (import delimited case(lower)) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); recodes bp3_2, bp3_2a, bp3_3-bp3_6 9 -> missing. mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's 2025 Q2 data dictionary labels each BP3_* column (e.g. BP3_1_02 'Problemas que enfrenta la ciudad: Deficiencias en la red publica de drenaje'; BP3_2 'Efectividad del gobierno de su ciudad para resolver problemas'; BP3_3 'Realizacion de tramite, pago o solicitud de forma directa ante un(a) servidor(a) publico(a) o empleado(a) de gobierno'; BP3_5 'Contacto directo con autoridades de seguridad publica (transito, municipales, estatales u otras)'); 23/23 agree in content with the 2025 Q2 questionnaire item carrying the same code number (3.1 options 01-16, 99; 3.2; 3.2a; 3.3-3.6). Step 3b, 2025 Q2 vs 2025 Q1 (checked, not assumed): 2025 Q2 has the Q2/Q4 SHAPE -- the corruption block (CP3 read-aloud definition + 3.3-3.6) is present in print (p.4-5, before Seccion IV. Acoso), in the 0625 diccionario (BP3_3..BP3_6 rows absent from 0325), catalogos (bp3_3..bp3_6.csv absent from 0325), raw CSV (23 BP3_* columns vs Q1's 19), .do Bookmark #7 (23 columns vs Bookmark #3's 19) and the live table (23 items). The 19 shared BP3_* diccionario rows are identical to 0325's; all 19 shared catalogos byte-identical to 0325's and all 23 byte-identical to 2024 Q4 (1224). Sections 3.1-3.2a: all 40 rows are string-identical to batch_690 (2025 Q1) apart from table/instrument/section_id names (diffed); option 12 printed 'fraudes, etcetera)' as in 2025 Q1 and 2024 Q4. Corruption block vs 2024 Q4 (batch_686), confirmed on a 150-dpi render of p.4: (a) CP3 is REWRITTEN -- 2025 Q2 prints 'Considere que las personas servidoras publicas o empleadas de gobierno son aquellas que trabajan en instituciones publicas. Por ejemplo: una policia, un juez, un medico o doctora, secretarias o personal administrativo de escuelas publicas, de hospitales, personal de limpia y recoleccion de basura, etcetera.' where 2024 Q4 printed 'Tome en cuenta que una persona servidora publica ... puede ser un(a) policia, personas que distribuyen apoyos de programas sociales ... Ministerio Publico, juez(a) ... Es decir, aquellas personas que trabajan en instituciones publicas.'; (b) 3.3 and 3.4 print 'un (una) servidor(a) publico(a)' where 2024 Q4 printed 'un(a)' -- shipped as printed (the same 'un (una)' change batch_693 found in Section II option 15); (c) 3.5 and 3.6 identical. Diccionario-only: BP3_6 label now '...u otra autoridad de seguridad publica' (1224: 'u otras autoridades'); BP3_1_99 'No sabe/no responde' (1224: 'No sabe/ no responde'). All 31 distinct Spanish strings shipped (3.1 stem, 17 options, 3.2-3.6 stems, CP3, printed options for 3.2-3.6) are found in the 2025 Q2 text layer after whitespace/dot-leader normalisation. Cross-check (route 9 style): all 48 live item x level counts (queried server-side via GROUP BY item,resp, no export) equal the raw INEGI 2025 Q2 CSV after the .do's recodes, 48/48 (e.g. bp3_1_01 0/1 = 7910/15807, bp3_1_16 0/1 = 23252/465, bp3_1_99 0/1 = 23706/11, bp3_2 1/2/3/4 = 806/6388/10012/5937, bp3_2a 1/2 = 7738/15221, bp3_3 1/2 = 7558/16148, bp3_4 1/2 = 653/6904, bp3_5 1/2 = 3106/20598, bp3_6 1/2 = 1379/1726); raw 23717 rows = 23717 live ids, 507363 live rows, no duplicate id x item, no missing resp -- not truncated (cf. batch_692). Code 9 set missing by the .do: bp3_2 98, bp3_2a 758, bp3_3 11, bp3_4 1, bp3_5 13, bp3_6 1. Routing (not a defect): bp3_2 blank for 476 = 465 (bp3_1_16 Ninguno) + 11 (bp3_1_99), per 'SI SE REGISTRO CODIGO 16 ... O 99 ..., PASE A 3.2a'; bp3_4 non-blank for exactly the 7558 bp3_3=Si (0 mismatches; 'PASE A 3.5'); bp3_6 non-blank for exactly the 3106 bp3_5=Si (0 mismatches; 'PASE A CP4'). Words: item_text / section_prompt are the administered 2025 Q2 questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials). Kept as printed: '(CIUDAD)' fill, '(a)'/'(una)' gender fills, 'etcetera)' in 12. Normalised: line wraps joined with a space; the visible double space in option 06 'limpia y  recoleccion' collapsed. Stripped: question numbers, option codes, dot leaders, 'ESPECIFIQUE' blank after Otro, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'C'; CIRCULE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES / UN SOLO CODIGO; skip instructions PASE A 3.2a / 3.5 / CP4). Tarjeta C is not in the questionnaire zip and was not transcribed. Structure (same as batch_677/686): section _1 = 3.1 (stem in section_prompt, option wording in item_text), _2 = 3.2, _3 = 3.2a, _4 = 3.3+3.4 (CP3 in section_prompt), _5 = 3.5, _6 = 3.6; instructions blank -- Section III has no whole-section introduction. Options: bp3_1_* are 0/1 flags for a circled code; option_text is INEGI's catalogo label ('0' = 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa', '1' = 'Si'), not questionnaire print. bp3_2 1-4 = Muy/Algo/Poco/Nada efectivo; bp3_2a, bp3_3-bp3_6 1/2 = Si/No -- printed and identical in the catalogos; code 9 'No sabe / no responde' has no row (set missing by the .do). Every level each item's respondents used has an option row (48/48 live item x resp cells). Step 3b instrument: live items match this question block exactly (23 = 17 + 1 + 1 + 4); dictionary Description ('Resident evaluations of local and federal government security performance, Q2 2025') overstates it -- nothing asks about the federal government; dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2025 Q2 wave (file suffix 0625) -- same defect as the siblings. INEGI-side cosmetic label defects, no effect on shipped text: BP3_1_09 label has a double space after the colon; BP3_4 label ends '...de algun beneficio ' (trailing space). English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation): reused verbatim from batch_690 (2025 Q1) for the 40 rows of 3.1-3.2a and from batch_686 (2024 Q4) for 3.3-3.6 item/option English (the 'un (una)' print change does not change 'a public servant'); section_prompt_translated for the rewritten CP3 on bp3_3/bp3_4 is translated fresh here. INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2025, segundo trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section III (questions 3.1-3.6) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, used INEGI's data-catalogue labels for the 0/1 checklist codes, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
